name: lodash-zipobject-pairs-form-entwine
behavioral_change: lodash v4.0.0 changed the accepted input of `_.zipObject`. In v_old it accepted either an array of [key, value] pairs or separate key and value arrays; in v_new only the two-array form remains and the pairs form moved to the new `_.fromPairs`. Passing a pairs array to v_new `_.zipObject` treats the whole array as keys, so every value becomes undefined, with no exception.
downstream_effect: The downstream project's `invertDependencies` in index.js builds pairs with `_.map` and passes them to `_.zipObject`; after the upgrade the inverted dependency table loses its content, `postwalk` and `prewalk` order changes, and two start/stop-order tests fail. The failures show only an order mismatch with frames in test/index.js and bluebird internals; zipObject, fromPairs, lodash and invertDependencies never appear, and index.js contains ten lodash calls including a second, unaffected two-argument `_.zipObject`.
reference_fix: The reference fix replaces `_.zipObject(...)` with `_.fromPairs(...)` in the single statement inside `invertDependencies` in index.js, leaving the two-argument `_.zipObject(v, v)` in `normalizeDependencies` untouched.
documented_in: The lodash Changelog for v4.0.0, Compatibility Warnings section, "Split out methods" list, states "Split `_.zipObject` into `_.fromPairs`" with no code block; the new form must be derived from the lodash 4.17.21 `_.fromPairs` jsdoc.
failing_tests: test/index.js :: system should start and stop components in dependency order
test/index.js :: system should allow mapping dependencies with different names
